## Import



BDRC security group mapping can be imported using the sitePairId#securityGroupMappingId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Bdrc/securityGroupMapping:SecurityGroupMapping example sitepair-1sxvs5oj#sgmap-b7teooa7
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
